When a merge candidate is rejected because it would exceed max_event_size, the pair is silently
dropped instead of being counted as rejected by the guard, so callers relying on
rejected_by_guard undercount rejections in size-limited merges.

N-grams silently drop the last character of the text because the sliding window is one character
short, so trailing text differences are missed during similarity comparisons.
